summary: The PR removes input validation for the discount percentage in `calculateDiscount`, allowing out-of-bounds percentages (such as negative values or percentages greater than 100%) to be processed without error.

findings.title: Removed percentage validation check
findings.description: Removing the bounds check (`percentage < 0 || percentage > 100`) allows invalid percentage inputs (e.g., -50% or 150%) to pass silently and compute incorrect prices (e.g., increasing price on negative discount or resulting in negative price on discounts > 100%) instead of throwing an 'Invalid discount percentage' Error.
findings.verificationHypothesis: Calling `calculateDiscount(100, -10)` or `calculateDiscount(100, 150)` will not throw an Error as expected for invalid percentages.

suggestedReproduction.preconditions: src.js is imported in Node.js environment.
suggestedReproduction.expectedBehavior: Should throw an Error with message 'Invalid discount percentage'.
